newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia '96 jobless nearly flat vs '95 at 15.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia '96 jobless nearly flat vs '95 at 15.5 pct.

text.p: Tunisia's 1996 unemployment rate was 15.5 percent, almost unchanged from 1995, a central bank report showed on Wednesday.

"Because of slower growth in the non-agricultural sectors and sluggishness in the increase of private investment, job creation in 1996 was below estimate, totalling 55,000 positions instead of the predicted 65,000," the report said.
Manufacturing jobs fell 12.5 percent to 14,000 positions from 1995 and government service employment jobs dropped to 7,000 posts from 10,200, it said.
Fisheries and non-agricultural jobs also declined in all sectors of activity except tourism and trade, the report said.
In the mining and energy sectors net job creation remained nil for the fifth consecutive year because of the adujstment policy being applied there, it said.
The report said during the last five years, 280,000 jobs were created, representing 87.5 percent of the initial forecasts.
